feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is the iteration 4 design (kd 0.15, ki 0, last_direction, x = +/-0.03 with 16 mm footprints) with base_speed restored to 1.4 and kp raised from 1.5 to 2.0. The base_speed change is a revert, and iteration 6 (base_speed 1.25) gave max_error of 0.0606, 0.0653 and 0.0657 m against 0.0607, 0.0648 and 0.0621 at 1.4, so speed is not the limit. The kp change is the one controller variable not yet tested cleanly. Iteration 0 used kp 2.0 but also had kd 0.05, a 12 mm footprint and base_speed 1.6, so it does not isolate kp. Every race so far has ended off track on all 60 trials with one line-loss event per trial and max_error of about 0.060 to 0.065 m. Geometry changes (iteration 2) and the integral and recovery-direction changes (iterations 3 and 5) did not move that figure. The candidate is valid, differs from the best raced design by one field (kp), and is cheap to race, so racing it is more useful than another revision.

Risk to watch: kp 2.0 with kd 0.15 may add oscillation. Each unit of turn is about 350 PWM, and signal can reach about 2, so turn can reach about 4.

What to change after the race, depending on its telemetry. (a) If max_error falls to 0.06 m or below, or line_loss_events drops to 0 or 1 on some seeds, keep kp 2.0 and check progress and completion_time against the iteration 4 values (progress 0.11 to 0.16, no completions). (b) If steering_oscillation rises sharply with no gain in max_error, revert kp to 1.5 and kd to 0.1 (the iteration 1 values). (c) If max_error and line-loss count are unchanged (about 0.060 to 0.065 m, one loss per trial), gain tuning is exhausted. Then test outer-sensor footprint or spacing changes, keeping the spread near +/-0.03 because the +/-0.05 spread cut progress in iteration 2.
requested_changes: If max_error falls to 0.06 m or below, or line_loss_events falls to 0 or 1, keep controller.kp = 2.0 with kd 0.15 and ki 0, and check progress and completion_time against iteration 4 (progress 0.11 to 0.16, no completions) before changing anything else.

If steering_oscillation rises sharply with no gain in max_error (iteration 4 showed kd 0.15 alone at about 0.073 to 0.148), revert controller.kp to 1.5 and controller.kd to 0.1 so the controller returns to the iteration 1 values.

If max_error and line_loss_events are unchanged (about 0.060 to 0.065 m, one loss per trial), gain tuning is exhausted. Keep base_speed 1.4 and test a smaller outer-sensor footprint (sensor_size 0.012) with sensor_positions still near x = +/-0.03, since the 16 mm footprint sees the tape only within about 0.02 m of the line.
